claims.quote: Whole-exome sequencing of iPSCs derived from FCD II patients revealed a novel NPRL3 C.767G > C (p.R256P) heterozygous mutation.
The effect of the newly identified NPRL3 mutation found in one of our FCD II patients was evaluated using the personalized cortical organoid model and the NPRL3 knockout HEK293T cells.

claims.object_text: larger organoids with increased p-S6+ cells and NeuN+ neurons
claims.quote: Cortical organoids generated from iPSCs of FCD II patients were larger than control iPSCs, with increased number of p-S6+ cells and NeuN+ neurons.

claims.object_text: overexpression with NPRL2 reduces p-S6 upon amino acid starvation
claims.quote: In NPRL3 knockout HEK293T cells, overexpression of NPRL3 together with NPRL2 protein is necessary to reduce p-S6 level upon amino acid starvation.

claims.object_text: reduced binding to NPRL2 leads to downregulation of NPRL3 and NPRL2 protein levels
claims.quote: The reduced binding between NPRL3 Arg256Pro and NPRL2 protein leads to downregulation of the relative total protein amount of both proteins in the cell.
The mutation of NPRL3 Arg256Pro impaired the function of NPRL3 protein via affecting the binding with NPRL2 protein, which resulted in unstable protein monomer.
